Theme

Household, washing & chores

hair dryer noun

modern

Traupman 123

īnstrūmentum siccātōrium capillōrum

A modern descriptive phrase.

Other words

  • māchinula favōnia — hair dryer

    also used · modern · Andresian p. 4

    “The west-wind machine”, on Favōnius, the warm west wind, used as an adjective; a playful name.

  • favōnius, favōniī m. — hair dryer

    noun, second declension · also used · modern · Traupman 325

    Classically Favōnius is the warm west wind (see west wind); Traupman uses it for a hair dryer.

Examples

  • Ēgressum pater linteō tersit capillīsque īnstrūmentum siccātōrium admōvit.

    When he got out, Dad dried him with a towel and held the hair dryer to his hair.composed

See also tumble dryer, hair.
